en: Osmium is the densest naturally occurring element, with a density of 22.59 grams per cubic centimeter, which is twice as dense as lead.
Seawater contains about 35 grams of dissolved salts per liter, compared to less than half a gram of salt in fresh drinking water.
Water expands by about 9 percent in volume when it freezes into ice, which is why solid ice floats on liquid water.
When liquid water boils into steam at 100 degrees Celsius, it expands to occupy about 1,700 times more volume than it did as a liquid.
A single drop of water contains approximately 1.5 sextillion water molecules, meaning it holds roughly 1,500,000,000,000,000,000,000 individual molecules.
Mayonnaise is an emulsion mixture containing about 80 percent vegetable oil and 15 percent water, stabilized by egg yolk.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all pure metals, requiring a massive 3,422 degrees Celsius to change from a solid to a liquid.
The Sun is made of plasma, a state of matter where gases are heated to over 5,500 degrees Celsius at its visible surface.
Bronze is a solid mixture of copper and tin, typically containing 88 percent copper and 12 percent tin to make it harder than pure copper.
On the Mohs hardness scale, diamond is the hardest natural mineral at a 10, while talc is the softest at a 1.
At 20 degrees Celsius, water can dissolve a maximum of 360 grams of table salt per liter before the liquid solution becomes completely saturated.
Gallium is a solid metal at room temperature but melts into a liquid at exactly 29.76 degrees Celsius, meaning it melts in your hand.
